design_philosophy: A command-center feel for elite project management. Prioritizes data density, optical clarity, and strict visual hierarchy. Eschews decorative noise in favor of functional geometry and high-contrast signaling for risks and AI insights. Surfaces should feel tactile but razor-sharp.

hierarchy.h1: text-4xl sm:text-5xl lg:text-6xl font-black tracking-tighter leading-none
hierarchy.label: text-xs font-bold uppercase tracking-[0.2em] text-muted-foreground

rules: No Inter or generic sans for headings.
Use font-mono for numeric data, IDs, and risk scores.
Section labels must be uppercase with wide letter-spacing.
Strict line heights: leading-none for H1/H2, leading-relaxed for body.

spacing_and_layout.general: Dense, highly structured grids with generous padding inside containers to prevent text collision.

grid_modes.dashboard: The 'Control Room' Grid: grid-cols-1 md:grid-cols-3 lg:grid-cols-4 with gap-4 or gap-6.
grid_modes.analytics: Bento Layout: mix col-span-1, col-span-2, row-span-2 for varying data widgets.
grid_modes.forms: Max width md (max-w-md) for login, centered. Max width 3xl for project creation.

surface_strategies.cards: Flat background (bg-card), 1px solid border (border-border), no shadows. 4px border radius (rounded-sm). On hover: border-primary/50.
surface_strategies.header: Crystal Glassmorphism: bg-background/60 backdrop-blur-xl border-b border-white/10 sticky top-0 z-50.
surface_strategies.ai_insights_panel: The 'Tracing Beam' effect: Subtle moving gradient border or neon inner glow (drop-shadow-[0_0_8px_rgba(2,132,199,0.3)]) to indicate AI activity.

padding_scale: Use p-6 or p-8 inside primary data cards.
Use py-12 or py-16 for section spacing.

customization_rules: Override default shadcn radius to 0.25rem (4px) globally.
Remove heavy shadows from default shadcn components; rely on 1px borders.
Forms must use shadcn Input, Select, and Form components, fully styled to match the dark theme.
Use data-testid attributes on ALL interactive elements (e.g., data-testid='create-project-btn').

specialized_libraries.charts: recharts (for team workload and delay prediction analytics)
specialized_libraries.dependency_graph: reactflow (MANDATORY for rendering the interactive task dependency network graph)
specialized_libraries.animations: framer-motion (for micro-interactions, AI loading states, and page transitions)

specific_components.ai_summary: Should be visually distinct. Use a subtle bg-primary/10 background with a solid primary-colored left border (border-l-4 border-primary) and a spark icon.
specific_components.risk_indicators: Use badge components with high-contrast background colors: bg-destructive/20 text-destructive for high risk, bg-warning/20 text-warning for medium.
specific_components.tables: Dense rows, no alternating background colors. 1px bottom border for rows. Hover state: bg-muted/50.

motion_and_interaction.hover_states: Crisp and immediate. Elements should have transition-all duration-200. Cards should NOT lift up, but borders should illuminate.
motion_and_interaction.ai_loading: Use a subtle pulsing opacity or an ASCII-style terminal loader rather than a generic spinner.
motion_and_interaction.page_transitions: Fade in with a slight upward translation (y: 10, opacity: 0 -> y: 0, opacity: 1).

hero_login_background.description: Abstract dark network nodes to be used as a low-opacity background for the Login/Signup page.
hero_login_background.usage: Use with bg-black/80 overlay to ensure text contrast.

ai_insights_graphic.usage: Can be used as a thumbnail or subtle background inside the AI Insights page/panel header.

instructions_to_main_agent: Install and configure React Flow (reactflow) for the Dependency Graph page. This is critical for visualizing task dependencies and critical chains.
Install and use Recharts for the Team Analytics page (bar charts for workload, line charts for progress).
Ensure the application follows a strict dark mode theme (no light mode toggle required, it is a native dark application).
Do NOT use generic card shadows. Stick to the 1px border philosophy defined in the surface strategies.
Implement the AI summary panel with the primary color accent to differentiate it from standard data tables.
Every page must have a top navigation or a side navigation that stays sticky.
Inject 'data-testid' on all core interaction elements (buttons, inputs, specific task cards) for testing.
